subject: Proposal update: multi-year prepay + milestone invoicing (Net 90 exception request)
messages:

Cc: Procurement <procure@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood pricing structure question — multi-year prepay + payment terms

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team's excited about the performance numbers. We're running this through procurement now and I'd like to clarify a couple of things before we loop legal:

- FinLytics prefers Net 90 payment terms on vendor contracts. Is Redwood able to support Net 90 if we do a multi-year prepay?
- We're evaluating a 3-year commitment but would like to structure payments around milestones tied to feature adoption (quarterly usage ramps). Would Redwood accept a partial upfront prepay + milestone invoices thereafter?

Can you share any packaging examples or precedent where Redwood has combined term discounts with milestone invoicing? If there's a short worksheet or sample order form that shows ramp-based billing and the associated discount tiers, that would be very helpful.

Also tagging our procurement lead Tom on CC — he may have some specific language we'll need.

Best,
Sarah Klein
Procurement Manager
FinLytics, Inc.

Attachment: none
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Procurement <procure@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 13:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing structure question — multi-year prepay + payment terms

Sarah — thanks for the clear note and for surfacing this early. Quick answers up front, followed by a couple of concrete options (details attached):

1) Net 90 requests: we can consider a Net 90 exception when there's significant prepaid commit or milestone-triggered invoices that reduce credit exposure. This is not standard, but we've approved similar structures for enterprise customers.

2) Partial upfront + milestone invoicing: yes — common pattern is either a) annual prepay per year with milestone credits applied, or b) multi-year prepay with an escrowed portion released on milestones.

Attached: pricing-summary-3yr.xlsx (tiered discount by ARR), SOW-milestones.xlsx (example ramp + milestone triggers), and our editable Order Form (FinLytics_Redwood_OrderForm_v2.pdf).

Two practical options we recommend for FinLytics based on your ramp comment:

Option A — Accelerated prepay (lower administrative overhead):
- 3-year term, 15% term discount vs list for full 100% prepay OR
- 60% upfront prepay (billed at signature), 40% invoiced against quarterly milestones; Net 90 allowed on milestone invoices once upfront is received.

Option B — Milestone-led prepay (aligns payments to adoption):
- 3-year term, annual invoices per-year but with 1st-year 50% prepay at signature, remaining 50% split into 2 milestone invoices (months 4 & 8) billed Net 90; subsequent years invoiced annually in advance. Term discount is tiered (10% year 1, 12% year 2, 15% year 3) tied to committed annual spend.

If you have a preferred cashflow profile, we can model the exact numbers and share a redline-ready order form for your legal team. Marcus (cc) — please confirm that finance can accept Option A with Net 90 on milestone invoices after upfront receipt, and that we can document that in the Order Form.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: pricing-summary-3yr.xlsx, SOW-milestones.xlsx, FinLytics_Redwood_OrderForm_v2.pdf
From: Procurement <procure@finlytics.com>

Cc: Tom Berger <t.berger@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 09:17:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood pricing structure question — multi-year prepay + payment terms

Jasmine — thanks for the options and the docs. A few clarifying points from FinLytics finance/procurement:

- FinLytics needs Net 90 on all invoices as a firm requirement unless full prepayment is provided. We can be flexible on prepay percentage but Net 90 must apply to milestone and annual invoices.
- We prefer ramp-linked invoicing: it helps our internal GAAP treatment. Suggestion: 40% upfront at signature, 30% at 6 months trigger (post-adoption milestone), 30% at 12 months (end of ramp), all billed Net 90.
- Can Redwood agree to a 12% term discount for a 3-year commitment with the above schedule? If not, what's the max discount you can offer with 40/30/30?

Tom is looping in for final approval on the overall commercial. We'll also need a short clause in the Order Form that explicitly states: "Net 90 payment terms apply to all invoices unless written exception is granted upon receipt of full prepayment."

Regards,
FinLytics Procurement Team

Attachment: internal_fin_requirements.xlsx (sent internally)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 11:05:02 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pricing structure question — multi-year prepay + payment terms

Team — forwarding FinLytics' preferred schedule (40/30/30, Net 90 on milestones). Need quick alignment on these asks before I respond with a formal counter:

Key asks from FinLytics:
- Net 90 on milestone invoices (must be honored across the three payments)
- 12% term discount for 3-year commit with the 40/30/30 payment profile
- Explicit Order Form language on Net 90 exception being conditional on full prepayment

My read: we can accept Net 90 on milestone invoices if there's sufficient upfront cash to mitigate exposure. Proposed counter: 35% upfront, 35% at 6 months, 30% at 12 months; 11% term discount for 3-year commit. If finance/legal are comfortable, we can commit to Net 90 on the two later invoices after upfront clears.

Grace — will legal require additional language about dispute/late-payment interest? Vivek — can finance model exposure for 35/35/30 and confirm the impact on ARR recognition and churn-adjusted economics (send quick numbers)? Marcus — if we land at 11%, can you confirm this fits our channel/comp guidelines for AE commission?

Thanks — I'm aiming to have a customer-facing counter by EOD Pacific.

Subject: Final commercial proposal: 3-year commit (35/35/30) + Net 90 on milestone invoices

Sarah / Team — appreciate the patience while we aligned internally. Below is Redwood's formal counter based on your ramp preference: 

Commercial summary (counter):
- Term: 3 years
- Committed ARR: $1,500,000 year 1 (scaling per SOW)
- Payment profile: 35% upfront at signature, 35% at 6 months (milestone 1), 30% at 12 months (milestone 2)
- Payment terms: Net 90 applies to the 6- and 12-month invoices. Upfront payment due at signature; no Net 90 on upfront.
- Term discount: 11% off list for the 3-year committed pricing (applies across years).
- Default/interest: 1.5% monthly interest on overdue amounts after 120 days; disputes must be raised within 30 days of invoice.

We can accept your requested Net 90 on milestone invoices conditioned on receipt of the 35% upfront payment. That phrasing will be added to the Order Form: 

"Net 90 payment terms shall apply to milestone and periodic invoices provided Redwood has received the upfront payment specified in the Order Form. Absent receipt of upfront payment, Redwood reserves the right to suspend services and charge standard invoicing terms."
